extraction.interpretation: final_norm sequence position t is the state after consuming token t. A pre-token state is at t-1, not the input embedding at t. GRU is causal, so task suffix cannot affect earlier states.
extraction.one_line_value_token: zero-based t=4+2*(i-1), where that token is x_i; before=t-1, after=t. Use the transformed input permutation when extracting inverse-target edges.
extraction.cycle_value_token: Integer values occur once each at t=4,6,...,2*n+2, in canonical-cycle order. Adjacent cycle values encode directed arcs; the final-to-first arc is established by the cycle delimiter/end. Physical token indices must be bound to decoded cycle arcs explicitly; they are not one-line positions.
extraction.frozen_forward_policy: Read hash-bound checkpoints; model.eval(); torch.inference_mode(); float32 parameters/activation export and no autocast; hook net.final_norm for full sequence; do not instantiate optimizer. Verify state_dict hash before/after and saved prefix_final agreement at registered tolerance2e-5.
extraction.cache_search_scope: Declared fields in the existing historical evaluation index and the120 selected current validation/test NPZ records, plus bounded filename search in historical evaluation and current unit02 feature folder. This is not a search of every disk path.

limitations: Activation values are checked against hash-bound extraction provenance, not independently re-forwarded by this audit.
Historical shared initialization is a saved value-preserving key migration of the actual pre-training state; it is not reconstructed from a seed.
Some historical completion receipts retain missing_authorized status despite actual valid trained20k payloads. Actual checkpoint headers and states are checked and caveats retained.
No token-state cache is declared in the selected source schemas. The source index has per-layer prefix states, not a token time axis.
Main all-length equal1/21 and count-matched sensitivity are analysis decisions beyond this source inventory; no outcome scores were computed.
